title: Normalize Writer Plugin Crate To Consistency Contract
description: Normalize writer/plugin/rs/lib.rs to the repo-wide Consistency Contract (Wave 3, mechanical pass): adopt PanelKit (tree_item/PanelTreeBuilder) from semio_framework_plugin for build_document_tree; adopt Terminology (app_labels!/LocaleLabels/resolve_labels/localized_label_map/AppLabelsOverlayExt) replacing the hand-rolled WriterLabels struct+consts+resolver and writer_action_labels/writer_utility_labels bodies; verify .resource_kind(...) is present; rename WriterApp -> WriterPlayApp (app id "writer-play" matches C1); fix region markers (rename registration region to "🔖Manifest" if needed, tests region to "🧪Tests", fix emoji-less/inconsistently-spaced region markers, reorder into canonical Constants -> Types -> DocumentHelpers -> Terminology -> CommandLabels -> Panels -> Render -> App impl(s) -> Manifest -> Tests order); adopt Testkit (meta/new_app/new_app_with_registry/paired_apps/assert_undo_redo_round_trip) replacing local scaffolding. Do NOT touch the hand-rolled JackLexer/JackParser/JackAst subsystem (reserved for a separate Wave-3 agent) beyond wrapping it in a DocumentHelpers region marker.
